expect_red: sweep: an occurrence is NAMED by what tells it apart from the other candidates, because `instance_name` does not

mutations.contract: All five pitch arms are recorded as `215071-001.2` and all three blade geometries as `211587-001.3`, so an occurrence is named at a reader by the part of its path that is not shared with the other candidates.
mutations.note: The mutation names it by the last segment always -- the obvious simplification, and the one that makes the bar say `215071-001.2` for whichever of the five arms was chosen. The residual beside it would still be right, which is what makes this the kind of wrong a reader believes.
